newsitem.title: UK: RTRS-Coffee growing making headway in Australia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Coffee growing making headway in Australia.

text.p: Coffee growing is making headway in Australia, a small producer, where more than 150,000 trees are being planted each year, statistician F.O. Licht said.
Australia is producing a meagre 5,000 60-kg bags a year but Licht said the expanding hectarage could significantly lift the output in the future.
"No local diseases or insect pests have been reported and the crop is grown without pesticides," it said in a report.
"High labour costs have forced growers to become world leaders in mechanisation," it added.
Licht said most coffee produced now was destined for the domestic market but small quantities were being exported.
Several large companies were said to be interested in acquiring land for coffee growing.
Licht gave no other details. The northern parts of Australia border Papua New Guinea and Indonesia, two major exporters.
